response.justification: The candidate is a strong and versatile full-stack/backend engineer with deep experience in web, mobile, and systems programming, but the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this role: native Japanese fluency, Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, embedded LAN-switch or networking security work, or hands-on C development for UNIX systems beyond a brief 2014-2015 stint. There is no mention of MACsec, 802.1X, network switch protocols, or embedded firmware development.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated systems-level programming ability (DLang, C/C++, async I/O, low-latency services)
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and technical leadership
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency, a hard requirement for this role
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or source modification experience
No background in embedded networking, LAN switches, or security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security/networking experience
Strong general software engineering skill set
